summary: postinstall fetches and executes binary from hardcoded bare IP with TLS verification disabled
details: On install, the package's postinstall script downloads a platform tarball from a hardcoded bare-IP HTTPS endpoint (https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz/<version>/onecode-linux-x64-<version>.tgz) with rejectUnauthorized: false, extracts it, chmods the contained binary to 0755, and links it into bin/.onecode so the CLI executes it. The destination is a bare IP address rather than any publisher-owned domain for @onescience/onecode, no hash or signature verification is performed on the downloaded bytes before they are made executable, and 301/302 redirects are followed while TLS certificate validation remains disabled. Anyone controlling that IP, its routing, or an on-path position between the installer and that IP can deliver arbitrary executable code that runs as part of the package's CLI on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
